title: A Reusable Semantic Web Framework for Evidence-Grounded Fundamental Rights Impact Assessments under the EU AI Act
reasoning: The paper focuses on legal and regulatory compliance (EU AI Act, Fundamental Rights Impact Assessments) and algorithmic fairness, particularly regarding bias and discrimination in high-risk AI. It evaluates an LLM's ability to classify risk evidence but does not evaluate or benchmark religion, moral reasoning, or philosophical ethical frameworks.
